title: Dances of the old days
summary: Punch recalls waltzes and two-steps danced for prizes and the freer dancing afterwards.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: What were some of the different kind of dances that they used to do?
Well, I used to dance shortas, waltz, pokers. When they were kind of dancing, they'd have been.
One step, two step. Used to dance two steps for prizes, you know. And waltzes for prizes.
Righty dancing in those days? Any righty dancing then?

Well, it'd be righty dancing, but it wouldn't be for no prize. You know, after the prize was over, they did all kind of dancing. But there wasn't no such thing as jitterbug. Just two-step guys squatting on the floor and coming up, shaking, you know, and all like that.
Just like they do at parades now.
That's the kind of stuff you used to do in the hall, yeah. Mm-hmm.
